name: robots/cpezzato__panda_simulation
title: Panda active-inference simulation
intro: Panda active-inference simulation, adapted from cpezzato/panda_simulation. It reads `read_joint_state` and `read_free_energy`; runs `set_joint1_effort`, `set_joint2_effort`, `set_joint3_effort`, `set_joint4_effort` and 3 more. `set_joint1_effort`: publish one effort command for panda_joint1 on /robot1/panda_joint1_controller/command; the AIC node may overwrite it, and while the world is paused no effort reaches the joint. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
